title: Implement the dimer model and solver
action: Implement the two-level dimer system described in the paper: two identical molecules with excitation amplitudes alpha and beta (alpha^2+beta^2=1) and dipole-dipole coupling V. Write a function or script that, given alpha, beta, V and an array of time points, computes the time-dependent wave functions psi1(t) and psi2(t) and the average interaction energy <V> using either direct evaluation of the analytical solutions or numerical integration/Fourier transform as derived in the paper.

title: Evaluate test cases and write verification results
action: Run the implemented solver on the specified test cases. For each case, compute the wave functions psi1(t), psi2(t) at the given time points and the average interaction energy <V>. Write the results to verification_results.json.
description: JSON file containing computed wave functions and interaction energy for each test case.
